data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'genehten' meaning 'to enter'. The name Gentry can be translated to 'Entrance' or 'Gatekeeper'. In medieval England, the name was given to those who lived near an entrance to a castle or manor. The name Gentry carries the meaning “Entrance, Gatekeeper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gentry usually hope their child will grow to embody entrance, gatekeeper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
